keyPoints: Hamare aas-paas har cheez kisi na kisi samagri (material) se bani hai — mez lakdi ki, khidki kaanch ki, bartan lohe ke aur thaila plastic ka hota hai.
Samagri ko uske gunon se pehchana jaata hai: kathor ya naram hona, chamkila ya feeka dikhna, paardarshi ya apardarshi hona aur paani me tairna ya doobna.
Dhatuen (metals) chamkili, majboot aur bijli-ushma ki achhi suchalak hoti hain, jaise loha, taamba aur aluminium; inhe peetkar patra ya taar banaya ja sakta hai.
Adhatuen (non-metals) aam taur par feeki, bhungur aur ushma-vidhyut ki kharab suchalak hoti hain, jaise lakdi, kagaz, koyla aur rubber.
Kuch samagri paani me tairti hain (lakdi, plastic, barf) aur kuch doob jaati hain (loha, patthar, kaanch) — ye unke ghanatva aur aakaar dono par nirbhar karta hai.
Samagri ka chayan kaam ke hisab se hota hai — khana pakane ke bartan ke liye dhatu, roshni ke liye kaanch aur bijli ke taar ke upar chadhane ke liye plastic chuna jaata hai.
Aam galti: chamkili har cheez ko dhatu samajhna; chamkila plastic ya kagaz bhi ho sakta hai, asli pehchan hamesha gunon ki jaanch se hoti hai.

title: Hamare Aas-Paas ki Vastuen
